article_text:
Nuisance Bear has become one of the most honored nonfiction films of the year, beginning with its world premiere in January right up to this very day. At Sundance, the feature directed by Gabriela Osio Vanden and Jack Weisman won the Grand Jury Prize for U.S. Documentary , and on Tuesday it earned a spot on the International Documentary Association’s list of the year’s best documentary films.

Related Stories

‘Nuisance Bear’ Trailer: In Oscar-Contending Documentary, Polar Bears And Humans Collide In Frigid North

Critics Choice Documentary Awards Nominations: ‘14th’ Nabs 6; Elizabeth Holmes Doc, ‘Once Upon A Time In Harlem’, ‘Nuisance Bear’ Land 5 Each

In between, Nuisance Bear claimed the James Balog Creative Vision Award at Mountainfilm Festival in Telluride and more than a dozen other awards, as well as racking up five nominations for the Critics Choice Documentary Awards. Not bad for a feature directorial debut.

RELATED: 2026-27 Awards Season Calendar: Oscars, Emmys, Grammys, Guilds & More

Watch on Deadline

Vanden and Weisman shot Nuisance Bear in Churchill, Manitoba, a frigid outpost on the Hudson Bay known as the “polar bear capital of the world.” The imposing ursine creatures spend a significant period in and around Churchill, especially around this time of year when their migratory routes draw them to the bay. Eco-tourists in ever-growing numbers head to the spot to catch a glimpse of the bears in their natural environment — and their not-so natural environment, meaning garbage dumps and other foraging spots.

The filmmakers join the latest edition of Deadline’s Doc Talk podcast to discuss their approach to the documentary, which subverts traditional nature films by adopting the bears’ point of view. Weisman and Vanden tell us about the moment they got the closest to a polar bear, which happened after one of the animals was hoisted in a net and relocated well outside of Churchill. They also share what they packed for their voyage into the frozen north.

RELATED: Married On Main Street: ‘Nuisance Bear’ Directors Tie Knot In Middle Of Sundance Film Festival

It’s a very chilly spot in fall and winter, but love between the directors warmed them as they made the film. The couple share the story of how they got engaged on Main Street in Park City in the middle of Sundance and how wedding bells immediately chimed.

That’s on the new episode of Doc Talk hosted by Oscar winner John Ridley ( 12 Years a Slave , Shirley ), and Matt Carey, Deadline’s senior documentary awards editor. The pod is a production of Deadline and Ridley’s Nō Studios.

Listen to the episode above or on major podcast platforms including Spotify , iHeart and Apple .

title_original: Wie man sich uneingeladen auf ein Galeriendinner schmuggelt
editorial_title_zh: 如何不请自来地混入画廊晚宴

editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "1. 年轻、漂亮且衣着光鲜。 2. 直接走进去。 3. 跟在一个穿白色西装、看起来像黑手党的人后面。他不会被拦下的。 4. 在一场有严格宾客名单核查的国际晚宴上：报一个柏林艺术研究所（Kunst-Werken）的名字。这个机构很有名，但没人知道这些名字怎么念。 5. 游说邀请方层级中的第三号人物——她虽然不知情，但渴望行使权力。 6. 与B级人物交朋友：厨房员工、门卫、活动组织者。 7. 调查秘密地点，稍微迟到一点，然后说你的直升机无法降落。德斯皮娜·斯托库（Despina Stokou）是一位艺术家，曾在柏林生活多年，现在住在洛杉矶。在那里去参加晚宴不幸变得更困难了，因为那里邀请了像本·斯蒂勒（Ben Stiller）这样的好莱坞明星，而这里只有拉尔斯·艾丁格（Lars Eidinger），不过好歹也有他。", "translated": true}]

article_text: 1. Sei jung, hübsch und gut angezogen. 2. Lauf einfach rein. 3. Schließe dich jemanden an, der einen weißen Anzug trägt und wie ein Mafioso aussieht. Er wird nicht aufgehalten werden. 4. Bei einem internationalen Dinner mit strenger Gästelistenkontrolle: Nenne einen Namen aus den Berliner Kunst-Werken. Die Institution ist bekannt, aber keiner weiß, wie sich die Namen aussprechen. 5. Bequatsche die Nummer drei in der Hierarchie der Einlader – sie weiß nicht Bescheid, will aber Macht ausüben. 6. Freunde dich mit den B-Leuten an: Küchenpersonal, Türsteher, Veranstalter. 7. Recherchiere die geheime Location, komme etwas zu spät und sage dann, dein Helikopter konnte nicht landen. Despina Stokou ist Künstlerin und wohnte jahrelang in Berlin, jetzt aber in Los Angeles, wo es leider schwieriger ist, auf ein Dinner zu kommen, weil da Hollywoodstars wie Ben Stiller eingeladen sind und hier nur Lars Eidinger, aber immerhin.

Michael Dash]译）。弗吉尼亚大学出版社 Caraf 图书系列，1989年。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《Paivapo (曾经……)》是出生于津巴布韦、现居开普敦的艺术家皮达·尼亚里里（Pyda Nyariri）在开普敦视觉艺术协会（AVA）举办的个展。这个标题俏皮地将艺术家定位为讲故事的人、植根于本土知识体系的警世故事的权威叙述者。在这个参照框架内，观者期待被引导走向一个被包裹着的、黑暗的、如子宫般安全的庇护所，或者至少是一个坚实的大地。这个关于一个名叫皮金（Pidgin）的捉摸不透的角色的故事，表面上将展示违背界限的后果：“听长辈的话，”换句话说。“看看鲁莽的皮金落得个什么下场。不要误入歧途。如果你这么做了，这就是你的下场。”", {"type": "paragraph", "text": "展览现场 | 《Paivapo (曾经……)》，皮达·尼亚里里在视觉艺术协会（AVA）的个展。开普敦。尼古拉·海莉（Nicola Helia）摄影", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "但尼亚里里大胆且引人深思的作品扰乱了观者脚下的坚实大地（terra 年的论文《跌跌撞撞的舞蹈》（“Stumble Dance”）中探讨了身体与地面关系的政治学。他认为，西方舞蹈通常将地面视为平坦的、中立的、非历史的，仅仅作为人类事件发生的舞台。相比之下，他提出了一种跌跌撞撞、被我们脚下沉淀的不规则性与历史所触动的政治学。这种跌跌撞撞打破了掌控，让我们向接触世界的新方式以及意想不到的方式敞开心扉。格里桑的颤抖也带有这种冲动。它坚信思想绝不能不惜一切代价寻求稳定性，而必须对裂缝、断裂以及关系那不可预测的基础保持敏感 "皮金（Pidgin）是一个既是幻影又是实体、“有分量的影子”的存在，它赋予了格里桑的关系诗学以虚构的形态。俏皮叛逆、不可遏制、慷慨大方、天生是个恶作剧者，皮金是混合的、偶然的、彩虹般变幻的、不断流转的、不断变形的、一个混乱且克里奥尔化的“由尘土制成的语法”。尽管它具有幽灵般的出场、是一种凭借直觉感知而非肉眼可见的虚构产物，但皮金依然深深扎根于大地之中并由大地构成，是一个无所不在的物质存在，拒绝被识别、分类和控制。皮金这一角色在艺术家浮雕压克力画作那不确定的字母中被隐约勾勒又隐去；穿过作为通往皮金世界门槛的半透明棉纱布、陶浆和木材作品；并通过丹尼斯·奥嫩（Denise Onen）的多声部声音作品中多孔的物质褶皱——那既是皮金的声音，也是整个展览诡异的“呼吸系统”。在这件作品中，仿佛一种崭新的语言、一种具身的、呼吸着的语言，正在意义之间的空间中、在大地本身的尘土中、在寂静的质地中被锻造出来。这是“普遍的”、“共同的”语言。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "政治理论家兼公共知识分子阿基勒·姆embe（Achille Mbembe）的话在此十分贴切。在 2020 年的一次“边缘理论”（“Theory of the Margins”）采访中，他重访了自己 2010 年的文本《走出黑夜：关于去殖民化的随笔》4 姆embe，阿基勒。《走出黑夜：关于去殖民化的随笔》。哥伦比亚大学出版社，2021年。并指出：", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "去殖民化……在哲学上……是对世界的一种根本性开放，是走向世界也让世界走进。如果你愿意的话，它是为了世界的深度呼吸，而不是自我封闭，而不是‘封闭性’（‘fermeture’）……那种固步自封的状态……这与从世界上分裂出去或再次瓜分世界毫无关系。它……关乎对大地以及所有居住在其中的生灵的根本性拥抱。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artthrob.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Pyda-Nyariri-Mutauro-wakagadzirwa-nehuruva-Grammar-made-from-dust-2026_detail-1024x819.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "ArtThrob", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Pyda Nyariri，《Mutauro wakagadzirwa nehuruva (Grammar made from dust)》，2026年。摄影：Nicola Helia", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "尼亚里里由拉伸棉纱布和陶土浆制成的作品体现了这种走向彻底开放的理念、这种柔和的多孔性，人们会被格里桑所说的“织物那可呼吸的质感，而非其成分的本质”所吸引。每一件诗意命名的作品都是一件独立的艺术品，但它并未与其大地语境隔绝。每一件作品都施有赭石或蓝色陶土浆等有机色调的颜料，与其他艺术品保持着动态对话，并对其周边环境保持开放。观者也成为了对话的一部分，在与一件艺术品的每一次相遇中发生蜕变，转而留下无形的痕迹，哪怕仅仅是一次看不见的呼气或一粒被惊扰的尘埃。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在此背景下，拉比亚·阿巴·奥马尔（Rabia Abba Omar）的虚构文本玩味了西方关于科学记录与法医调查的概念，挑逗着观者去寻找“低语守护者”（Keepers of Whispers）即 Pfimbi Yemashoko 艺术集体所提供的“人类学”档案元数据中的含义，他们记录了自己对皮金（Pidgin）的目击和感知。但这份经过严格记录的被整理的“低语合集”，是一件巧妙的非洲未来主义（Afrofuturism）思辨虚构作品，交织了科学与神话。就像皮金那模糊不定、隐约可见于浮雕丙烯画（被描述为“奇乌雷（Chivure）附近滕贝拉（Tembera）岩面上的雕刻”）中的字母表一样，伴随展览的“档案”文献在任何意义上都不是指称性的或指导性的。它是对一种强制性殖民意识形态的讽刺性评论，这种意识形态试图对“不守规矩的他者”进行排序和剥削，压制母语并从物质世界中掠夺宝贵的资源。它还暗示了通过当今新兴的复古民族主义和僵化的边界、算法监控、环境崩溃以及不断扩大的不平等，殖民式的他者化和剥削依然在持续。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artthrob.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Pyda-Nyariri-Vakaviga-mazwi-erukuvhute-They-buried-the-words-of-the-umbilical-cord-2025-1024x819.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "ArtThrob", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Pyda Nyariri，《Vakaviga mazwi erukuvhute (They buried the words of the umbilical cord)》，2025年。摄影：Nicola Helia", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "尼亚里里的一件艺术品带有这样的标题：“他们埋葬了脐带的话语”。既然母语已被埋葬，唯有大地——这“土地的骨髓”——还记得你的名字。但这种对源头、对原始意义的怀旧回归，被证明是一种幻象。正如皮金这个角色无休止地逃避着固定或单一的身份一样，“Paivapo”这个标题所唤起的“曾经”的时空也在无休止地向内折叠。“曾经”的意义是难以捉摸的、不确定的、不透明的；它从未是原始的，而总是不断消退、远离视线。在一次去殖民转向中，“Paivapo”成为了孕育激进乐观主义和重新构想的肥沃土壤，它不仅是一个向后看，也是向前看和向外看的姿态。故事遥远的地平线刻意保持开放，向外指向无限的可能，同时也向内指向某种凭直觉可知、可感、熟悉的事物：“地平线向内折叠以迎接它”。没有纯粹而独特的母语，只有某些事物在试探性成型的声音：口吃、绊跌、沉默和轻柔的低语：“它低语了一个悬浮在空中的轻柔词语”；“它由我们的集体呼吸塑造而成”。集体呼吸的混合声音暗示着一种新现实、新世界的萌芽，这正是格里桑所称的“人类多元的欢欣分化”之声。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "对源自大地红尘、浮于其上的超现实开闭式茧的虚构引用，暗示了一种全新、去殖民化的思考与存在方式的潜力，这是一只由其中一件作品所描述的“光明与尘埃”构成的虹彩蝴蝶。随着文化和语言的交汇、边界的消融，完全崭新且具有偶然性和平等主义的关联与存在形式将成为可能。从这个角度来看，棉纱布作品可能是葬礼裹尸布的残余，但它们也是敷在伤口上的透气纱布，是疗愈、修复和潜能的场域：“我们被包裹在其后果之中”；“我们见证了它的绽放”。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "棉纱布也让人联想到一艘船鼓胀的风帆，它正穿行于一个世界的无界、普遍的水域之中，在这个世界里，人类带着自身的偶然性，对大地的物质性以及居住其间的人类与非人类众生并不拥有主宰权。用格里桑的话来说：", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这就是为什么我们坚守诗歌。尽管……在我们从一个时代过渡到另一个时代时闪烁着令人疲惫的光芒——从森林到城市，从故事到计算机——但在船头依然有某种我们如今共同拥有的东西：这种低语、云朵、雨水或平静的烟雾。我们认识到自己既是部分又是群集，置身于一个并不令人恐惧的未知之中。我们发出诗歌的呐喊。我们的船只向所有人敞开，我们为所有人扬帆起航。 ——爱德华·格里桑，《关系诗学》 5 关系诗学。（Betsy Wing译）。密歇根大学出版社，1997年。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "注释", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "格里桑，爱德华。《加勒比话语：精选论文》。（J. Michael Dash译）。弗吉尼亚大学出版社 Caraf 图书系列，1989年。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "格里桑，爱德华。《关系诗学》。（Betsy Wing译）。密歇根大学出版社，1997年。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "姆贝米，阿奇尔。《走出黑夜：去殖民化随笔》。哥伦比亚大学出版社，2021年。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "弗莱施曼，汉娜。“大地在颤抖：爱德华·格里桑的群岛交流模型”。《Metropolis》，2025年10月15日。https://metropolism.com/nl/feature/the-earth-is-trembling-edouard-glissants-archipelagic-model-of-exchange/", "links": [{"text": "https://metropolism.com/nl/feature/the-earth-is-trembling-edouard-glissants-archipelagic-model-of-exchange/", "url": "https://metropolism.com/nl/feature/the-earth-is-trembling-edouard-glissants-archipelagic-model-of-exchange/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "彼得森，安吉琳。“阿奇尔·姆贝米在《边缘理论》访谈中探讨非洲未来主义、非洲都会主义与去殖民化”。《Brittle Paper》，2020年11月20日。https://brittlepaper.com/2020/11/achille-mbembe-tackles-afrofuturism-afropolitanism-and-decolonisation-in-theory-of-the-margins-interview/", "links": [{"text": "https://brittlepaper.com/2020/11/achille-mbembe-tackles-afrofuturism-afropolitanism-and-decolonisation-in-theory-of-the-margins-interview/", "url": "https://brittlepaper.com/2020/11/achille-mbembe-tackles-afrofuturism-afropolitanism-and-decolonisation-in-theory-of-the-margins-interview/"}], "translated": true}]

Drawing on the eminent postcolonial theorist, poet and novelist Édouard Glissant, the artist invokes a poetics and politics of illegibility and instability, a site of resistance to Western imperatives of transparency and knowability. In contrast, he proposes a politics of stumbling, of being moved by the irregularities and histories sedimented beneath our feet. The stumble disrupts mastery, opening us to new and unexpected ways of being in contact with the world. Glissant’s trembling shares this impulse. article_text:
A feature by Sandra Dodson on the 3rd of August 2026. This should take you 7 minutes to read.

AVA Gallery 18.06 - 30.07.2026

Opacities can coexist and converge, weaving fabrics. To understand these truly one must focus on the texture of the weave and not on the nature of its components. For the time being, perhaps, give up this old obsession with discovering what lies at the bottom of natures… Thought of self and thought of other here become obsolete in their duality…. What is here is open, as much as this there. I would be incapable of projecting from one to the other. This-here is the weave and it weaves no boundaries. Édouard Glissant, in Poetics of Relation 1 Poetics of Relation. (Translated by Betsy Wing). University of Michigan Press, 1997.

We must return to the point from which we started. Diversion is not a useful ploy unless it is nourished by reversion: not a return to the longing for origins, to some immutable state of Being, but a return to the point of entanglement, from which we were forcefully turned away; that is where we must ultimately put to work the forces of creolization, or perish? Édouard Glissant, in Creolization in the Making of the Americas 2 Glissant, Édouard. Caribbean Discourse: Selected Essays. (Translated by J. Michael Dash). The University Press of Virginia Caraf Books Series, 1989.

‘Paivapo (There once was …)’ is a solo exhibition by Zimbabwean-born, Cape Town-based artist Pyda Nyariri, at the Association for Visual Arts (AVA) in Cape Town. The title teasingly positions the artist as storyteller, authoritative narrator of a cautionary tale rooted in indigenous knowledge systems. Within this frame of reference, the viewer expects guidance towards a cocooned, dark, womb-like place of safety or, at the very least, a place of firm ground. The tale, about an elusive character called Pidgin , will ostensibly demonstrate the consequences of transgressing a boundary: “Listen to your elders,” in other words. “Look at what happened to adventurous Pidgin. Don’t go astray. This is what will happen if you do.”

Installation View | ‘Paivapo (There once was …)’, solo exhibition by Pyda Nyariri at the Association for Visual Arts (AVA). Cape Town. Photography by Nicola Helia

But Nyariri’s bold and thought-provoking work unsettles the terra firma beneath the viewer’s feet and throws up a fine, obscuring red dust. It is as if the earth itself is breathing, trembling, its skin a site of exchange. Drawing on the eminent postcolonial theorist, poet and novelist Édouard Glissant, the artist invokes a poetics and politics of illegibility and instability, a site of resistance to Western imperatives of transparency and knowability. Hannah Fleishman, commenting on curator Hans Ulrich Obrist’s recent archival exhibition on Glissant’s work at West Den Haag, makes a resonant comment:

[I]n his essay “Stumble Dance” (2008) [theorist André Lepecki] considers the politics of the body’s relationship to the ground. Western dance, he argues, often treats the ground as flat, neutral, ahistorical, as merely a stage for human happening. In contrast, he proposes a politics of stumbling, of being moved by the irregularities and histories sedimented beneath our feet. The stumble disrupts mastery, opening us to new and unexpected ways of being in contact with the world. Glissant’s trembling shares this impulse. It insists that thought must not seek stability at all costs but must remain sensitive to cracks, ruptures and the unpredictable ground of relation 3 Fleishman, Hannah. “The earth is trembling: Édouard Glissant’s archipelagic model of exchange.” Metropolis, 15 October 2025. https://metropolism.com/nl/feature/the-earth-is-trembling-edouard-glissants-archipelagic-model-of-exchange/. Accessed 22 July 2026. .

Pyda Nyariri, Kwatanura chisununguke (Peel and let it be free) , 2026. Photography by Nicola Helia

Pidgin, a being both phantom and physical, “a shadow that holds weight,” gives fictional form to Glissant’s poetics of relation. Playfully rebellious, irrepressible, generous, by nature a trickster, Pidgin is hybrid, contingent, iridescent, ever-shifting, ever-transforming, a chaotic, creolizing “grammar made from dust.” While a spectral presence, a figment intuited rather than seen, Pidgin is still very much in and of the earth, an all-pervasive material presence that resists identification, classification and control. The character of Pidgin is tantalisingly traced and effaced in the indeterminate alphabet of the artist’s raised-relief acrylic paintings; across the diaphanous works of cotton gauze, clay slip and wood that serve as a threshold into Pidgin’s world; and through the porous material folds of Denise Onen’s polyphonic sound piece, the voice of Pidgin that is also the uncanny “respiratory system” of the exhibition as a whole. In this piece it is as if a new language, an embodied, breathing language, is being forged in the spaces between signification, in the dust of the earth itself, in the texture of silence. It is the language of the “common,” the “all.”

The words of political theorist and public intellectual Achille Mbembe are apposite here. In a “Theory of the Margins” interview in 2020, he revisits his 2010 text Out of the Dark Night: Essays on Decolonisation 4 Mbembe, Achille. Out of the Dark Night: Essays on Decolonisation. Columbia University Press, 2021. and remarks:

Decolonisation is … philosophically … a radical openness, of and to the world. It is, if you want, a deep breathing for the world as opposed to an insulation, as opposed to ‘fermeture’ … the fact of closing in on oneself … It has nothing to do with seceding from the world, or partioning the world again. It has … to do with a radical embrace of the earth and of all who inhabit it.

Pyda Nyariri, Mutauro wakagadzirwa nehuruva (Grammar made from dust) , 2026. Photography by Nicola Helia

Nyariri’s pieces made of stretched cotton gauze and clay slip embody this notion of radical openness, this soft porousness, in which one is drawn to what Glissant calls “the breathable texture of the weave and not the nature of its components.” Each poetically titled piece is a distinct work of art but it is not insulated from its earthly context. Each work, pigmented with organic shades of ochre or blue clay slip, is in dynamic conversation with the other artworks and open to its surroundings. The viewer becomes part of the conversation too, transformed by each encounter with an artwork and leaving an invisible trace in turn, if only an unseen exhalation or a disturbed speck of dust.

Against this backdrop, Rabia Abba Omar’s fictional text plays with Western concepts of scientific documentation and forensic investigation, teasing the viewer into seeking meaning in the “anthropological” archival metadata provided by the Keepers of Whispers, the Pfimbi Yemashoko Collective, who have documented their sightings and sensings of Pidgin. But this collated “collection of whispers,” rigorously recorded, is an ingenious piece of Afrofuturist speculative fiction, imbricating science and myth. Like the obscure, indeterminate signifiers of Pidgin’s alphabet, visible in the raised-relief acrylic paintings described as “carvings in the rock-face of Chivure near Tembera,” the “archival” documentation that accompanies the exhibition is not denotative or instructive in any sense. It is an ironic commentary on a coercive colonial ideology that sought to order and exploit an “unruly other”, to suppress mother tongues and to extract valuable resources from the material world. It also hints at the persistence of colonial othering and exploitation, through today’s emerging retro-nationalisms and rigid borders, algorithmic surveillance, environmental collapse and widening inequality.

Pyda Nyariri, Vakaviga mazwi erukuvhute (They buried the words of the umbilical cord) , 2025. Photography by Nicola Helia

One of Nyariri’s artworks carries the title, “They buried the words of the umbilical cord”. Now that the mother tongue is buried, only the earth, the “marrow of the land”, remembers your name. But this nostalgic return to source, to originary meaning, is shown to be an illusion. Just as the character of Pidgin endlessly eludes a fixed or unitary identity, the time-space of the “once” invoked by the title “Paivapo” folds endlessly into itself. The meaning of “once” is elusive, indeterminate, opaque; never originary but always receding from view. In a decolonial turn, “Paivapo” becomes fertile ground for radical optimism and reimagining, a gesture of looking not only back but ahead and beyond. The distant horizon of the story is deliberately open-ended, gesturing outward towards infinite possibility but also inwards towards something intuitively known, felt, familiar: “The horizon folded inwards to greet it”. Instead of a pure and distinctive mother tongue, there are sounds of something tentatively coming into being: stuttering, stumbling, silence and soft whispers: “It whispered a soft word that hung in the air”; “It was shaped by our collective breath.” The hybrid sound of collective breath suggests the emanation of a new reality, a new world, the sound of what Glissant calls “the exultant divergence of humanities.”

The fictional reference to the surreally open-closed cocoons, emerging from the earth’s red dust and floating above it, suggests the potential for a new, decolonised way of thinking and being, an iridescent butterfly configured of the “brightness and dust” described in one of the artworks. As cultures and languages converge, as borders dissolve, entirely new forms of relation and presence, contingent and egalitarian, become possible. In this light, the cotton gauze artworks may be remnants of burial shrouds but they are also the breathable gauzes applied to a wound, sites of healing, repair and potentiality: “We are wrapped in its aftermath”; “We became witness to its blossoming.”

The cotton gauze also calls to mind the billowing sails of a boat traversing the unbounded, universal waters of a world in which humans, in their contingency, have no dominion over the earth’s materiality or over the human and non-human beings who inhabit it. In Glissant’s words:

This is why we stay with poetry. And despite … the exhausting flashes as we pass from one era to another – from forest to city, from story to computer – at the bow there is still something we now share: this murmur, cloud or rain or peaceful smoke. We know ourselves as part and as crowd, in an unknown that does not terrify. We cry our cry of poetry. Our boats are open, and we sail them for everyone. ― Édouard Glissant, Poetics of Relation 5 Poetics of Relation. (Translated by Betsy Wing). University of Michigan Press, 1997.

Notes

Glissant, Édouard. Caribbean Discourse: Selected Essays. (Translated by J. Michael Dash). The University Press of Virginia Caraf Books Series, 1989.

Glissant, Édouard. Poetics of Relation . (Translated by Betsy Wing). University of Michigan Press, 1997.

Mbembe, Achille. Out of the Dark Night: Essays on Decolonisation . Columbia University Press, 2021.

Fleishman, Hannah. “The earth is trembling: Édouard Glissant’s archipelagic model of exchange.” Metropolis , 15 October 2025. https://metropolism.com/nl/feature/the-earth-is-trembling-edouard-glissants-archipelagic-model-of-exchange/

article_text:
With a world in crisis and an art market spinning out of control, ace art-world consultants Chen & Lampert deliver a quiz full of hard choices for Art in America readers from far and wide.

Fall is traditionally a time to reflect, so we hereby offer up this Hard Choices quiz as a chance for you to evaluate the advice we’ve been offering Art in America readers since 2019. Have we helped? How have we hurt? Are things better today than they were before you considered our counsel? Answer the following questions to let us know how we’re doing and where we can improve. Please send your responses to hardtruths@artinamericamag.com or share them with us on social media.

1. Reading Chen & Lampert makes me feel: a) Seen b) Peeped c) Stalked 2. The best description of Hard Truths is: a) Satirical but earnest advice column b) Ethical North Star c) Art world snitch sheet

3. My favorite part of taking the Hard Choices quiz is always: a) Tallying the score b) Learning new words c) Renewing my pledge to “never do this again” 4. Following Chen & Lampert’s advice has made me into: a) A stronger artist and all-around better person b) An incurable troll c) A GOD

5. Reading Chen & Lampert over the years has convinced me to: a) Pursue my master’s degree b) Finish my PhD c) Flee the art world to become a therapist who treats artists who become therapists 6. Chen & Lampert have proven to me that: a) Others wrestle with similar professional and personal dilemmas b) I am completely alone in this world c) Art problems are for coastal elites 7. The thing I like least about reading Chen & Lampert is: a) Their snide tone b) Their mercy for sinners c) The rest of the magazine 8. If Art in America stopped publishing Hard Choices and Hard Truths, I would: a) Immediately unsubscribe b) Initiate a boycott c) Finally be free of the mind goblins they gave me

9. Another Penske Media publication I would like to see Chen & Lampert write for is: a) Robb Report b) Women’s Wear Daily c) Vibe d) All the above—and they should also headline an event at SXSW

10. Chen & Lampert are people I could imagine: a) Hiring as consultants b) Having a beer with at my local bar c) Avoiding at public functions because of the shame they induce

SCORES

10–16: While doomscrolling Hyperallergic and fuming over Timothée Chalamet’s disdain for the slow arts, you inform social media that “art criticism is dead” because Chen & Lampert are besmirching the hallowed legacy of Art in America with hooliganism and puerile jokes.

17–23: Your love of Chen & Lampert is heroic. You are there for our merch drops and cannot wait to subscribe to our future Substack, which we’ll be forced to make if/when they fire us. But you won’t let that happen, and neither will the Pulitzer committee.

24–30: Deep down you’ve always known that Chen & Lampert’s uncomfortable sociological tour of the art world is actually a bighearted ploy to shape a society where artists and art will flourish and save humanity. You look forward to making their dream a reality.

article_text:
Au cinéma, et en particulier dans le cinéma d’horreur, la maison peut souvent donner une forme aux peurs, aux angoisses et à l’intériorité de ses héroïnes.

Dans Mister Babadook par exemple, on suit la lutte d’une mère avec un monstre inquiétant, alors qu’elle est encore hantée par la mort de son mari. Et la réalisatrice Jennifer Kent a raconté avoir conçu ce décor comme une extension de l’intériorité de son héroïne. Elle utilise alors des couleurs froides et sombres pour signifier le chagrin de cette mère et on peut aussi voir dans le sous-sol effrayant, la métaphore d’un inconscient où la douleur reste enfouie.

Racines gothiques

Cette idée de faire de la maison une manifestation de la subjectivité d’une héroïne, on la retrouve sous différentes formes dans Répulsion (1965), Mother! (2017) ou même La proie de l’ombre (2020).

Mais ces maisons ne racontent pas uniquement ce qu’il se passe dans la tête des héroïnes, elles racontent aussi ce qu’on leur fait subir. Et cette association entre espace domestique, souffrance et enfermement trouve ses racines dans la littérature et le cinéma gothiques.

Dans sa nouvelle Le Papier Peint Jaune (1892), l’autrice Charlotte Perkins Gilman raconte l’enfermement d’une femme que son mari médecin empêche d’écrire et de travailler, après la naissance de leur enfant. Elle finit alors par se convaincre que d’autres femmes sont coincées derrière la tapisserie des murs de sa chambre. Ici, l’image de la maison hantée devient pour l’autrice une manière de dénoncer l’aliénation domestique des femmes, prises au piège par leur époux dans leur propre foyer.

Quelques décennies plus tôt, dans Jane Eyre (1847) de Charlotte Brontë, les événements étranges dont l’héroïne est témoin à Thornfield dissimulent un secret tragique : celui de Bertha, une femme maintenue captive par son mari dans une pièce sous les combles.

Ce personnage inspirera plus tard l’essai féministe La Folle dans le grenier de Sandra Gilbert et Susan Gubar. Et dans son ouvrage Sortir de la maison hantée , Pauline Chanu interrogera à son tour la manière dont ces étiquettes de “folles” et “hystériques” contribuent à masquer les violences subies par les femmes.

Rebecca , écrit par Daphné du Maurier en 1938 puis adapté au cinéma par Alfred Hitchcock en 1940, propose une variation sur le rapport entre souffrance féminine et maison hantée. On suit l’histoire d’une femme qui vient d’emménager avec son nouveau mari et qui sent sa nouvelle demeure comme hantée par la première épouse de ce dernier, décédée dans des conditions mystérieuses…

Cet héritage gothique continue d’infuser les récits contemporains, notamment chez Guillermo del Toro qui reprend cette idée d’une demeure hantée et de fantômes qui viennent prévenir une femme du danger dans Crimson Peak (2015).

Foyer menaçant

Mais le thriller domestique contemporain réactive aussi ces motifs pour dénoncer plus directement les violences conjugales. C’est le cas notamment dans Invisible Man (2020) dans lequel une femme fuit son compagnon violent. Celui-ci simule alors sa mort et utilise une technologie pour devenir invisible et continuer à la terroriser et à la faire passer pour instable.

Ce procédé de discréditation est aussi au cœur de La femme de ménage (2025), où un mari va même jusqu’à utiliser son grenier comme une véritable salle de torture tandis que son épouse est perçue comme “folle”.

Si dans ces nouvelles maisons hantées les fantômes disparaissent, le foyer lui, reste bien un lieu menaçant où les femmes doivent affronter seules les violences.

▌ À LIRE AUSSI

Nos 7 films de fantômes préférés

title_original: Pope.L review – savage satire from Y-fronts-wearing trickster famed for gruelling ‘crawl’ across New York
editorial_title_zh: Pope.L 展评——这位因在纽约进行艰苦“爬行”而闻名、身穿 Y 字裤的怪才带来的残酷讽刺
editorial_excerpt_zh: 伦敦现代艺术馆（Modern Art）已故美国艺术家 Pope.L 向自由主义的自以为是及黑人文化的商业化发起挑战，甚至曾身穿白色兔耳装和底裤。墙上钉着七个方框，每个方框都以美国极简主义的高超风格绘制：纯粹、严苛的主题变奏……

true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "可以确定的只有一点：Pope.L article_text:
S even squares are pinned to the wall, each one painted in the high style of American minimalism: pure, austere variations on a theme. At the centre of each is printed the phrase “negro idea” followed by an apparently random number (51, 37, 666). What is Pope.L, the late, great trickster of contemporary American art, getting at?

Perhaps it is a critique of how minimalism, with its ethos of art-for-art’s sake, excluded politics from art? Or a comment on how racial categories are as constructed (and as subject to fashion) as the theories underpinning contemporary art? Or is it a riff on how the edifice of western modernism is built on stolen ideas? Then again, maybe the deployment of an outmoded racial category is simply designed to discomfort the liberal pieties of those people likely to visit this art gallery just off Piccadilly.

All that is certain is that Pope.L cannot be pinned down. Best known for his gruelling “crawl” across New York, this influential artist and writer didn’t use art to make himself understood. Instead, he used its tools to dismantle the liberal presumption that other people and communities can easily be understood, categorised and explained away. He was less interested in being “seen” than in making his audience look again at themselves and the world, and paved the way for a new generation of artists for whom identity – in the sense of conforming to external expectations – is not only a creative trap but a form of control.

This is most apparent in Pope.L’s deep suspicion of the commercialisation of Black culture, and the stereotypes that serve to commodify and defuse it. His satire is savage and furious, closer in spirit and ambition to the provocations of Dada than to any more straightforward satire of the art world. Take the photograph Foraging (Mr Mau Mau), in which he appears in white Y-fronts and white bunny ears, with a note pinned to his chest referencing the Kenyan anti-colonial uprising (and Britain’s notoriously brutal repression). More Y-fronts are framed on the walls, smeared in brown and white fluid and handwritten insignia (“I have something important to share with you – Cliff G”). The numbered series is entitled Real Kitsch.

The way that words and images settle into fixed categories (cliche and kitsch, respectively) is a recurring theme. In Identity What We Lose to Real For, completed a year before the artist’s death in 2023 , block wooden letters like those used to teach children the alphabet fall off their frame, further confusing a short text that reads like a dense concrete poem. The surface is spattered with paint, recalling painterly expressionism and a toddler’s paint-flinging (neighbouring series of scrawled Xs and Os likewise summon conceptual painting and a half-understood game of noughts and crosses). Art here is dismantling conventional ways of thinking and naming.

Short films documenting a selection of Pope.L’s performances are screened in a back room. Dressed in a figure-hugging Superman costume and with a skateboard strapped to his back, the artist crawls on his belly from the Statue of Liberty to the Bronx. As he is barracked by strangers, you wonder why so many are offended by the performance yet unmoved by the numerous homeless people in New York.

In a performance-lecture he situates his work on the “sidewalk of national consciousness”, and the world crowds into every work in this show: a white painting might look like a romantic abstraction but is in fact, as the text along its edge tells us, a picture of Martin Luther King’s Dick as Seen from Pluto. Fifteen years after Pope.L made this gag, incidentally, research was undertaken on Kazimir Malevich’s 1915 Black Square. It was discovered that the monochrome painting, long hailed as an icon of art’s transcendent possibilities, had a hidden title: Negroes Battling in a Cave.

Here is more evidence for Pope.L’s argument that art can never entirely be insulated from the nature of the world that produces it, no matter how pure a painting might appear to the eye. This point is most clearly illustrated by his long-running and highly complex engagement with the work of Robert Ryman (a survey of whose monochrome white paintings is now on show at the Barbican in London).

Pope.L memorably described himself as “the son” of Ryman and therefore duty-bound to “walk in his footsteps to the front door of the family mansion and burn it to the ground”. While it is a shame that this show does not include more of his direct responses to the painter, the two exhibitions can constructively be seen in counterpoint.

article_text:
Japanese animated phenomenon “ Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island ” tightened its grip on the South Korean box office over the weekend of Oct. 16–18, commanding more than 42% of nationwide ticket revenue in its third frame.

According to data from KOBIS, the tracking service operated by the Korean Film Council, the Toho-distributed fantasy feature generated $2.8 million from 378,474 admissions across 1,181 screens, accounting for a dominant 42.7% of the weekend market.

Related Stories

Hulu's Mother-Son Mystery 'Phony' Mutes Connie Britton's Charisma Under Visual Effects: TV Review

Directed by Kei Oikawa and adapted from the popular manga by Nagano, the animated adventure follows the titular small character and companions traveling to an island paradise before confronting a mysterious aquatic legend. The release has lifted its cumulative South Korean gross to $14 million from 1,828,909 total admissions since its Sep. 30 launch.

Popular on Variety

Director Hur Jin-ho’s controversial political crime thriller “ The Assassin(s) ” held second place, pulling in $1 million from 140,017 admissions across 1,104 screens to capture 15.5% of the weekend market. Distributed by Hive Media Corp, the period drama reconstructs the August 15, 1974 assassination attempt on President Park Chung-hee and stars Yu Hae-jin, Park Hae-il, and Lee Min-ho as investigators probing inconsistencies in the official state inquiry.

The production’s commercial run continues against persistent political blowback and legal challenges, with conservative civic organizations and bereaved family groups filing defamation complaints alleging historical distortion over its suggestion of internal state culpability in the shooting that killed First Lady Yuk Young-soo. Despite protests that previously disrupted promotional appearances and prompted 19 local film industry guilds to issue a joint statement defending cinematic expression, the title has crossed the three-million-ticket threshold, lifting its cume to $23.7 million from 3,249,174 admissions since its Sep. 23 rollout.

CJ ENM’s gambling crime drama “Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub” maintained third place in its fourth weekend, generating $731,309 from 94,314 admissions across 789 screens for a 10.8% share of receipts. Directed by Choi Kook-hee and starring Byun Yo-han, Noh Jae-won, and Ayaka Miyoshi, the fourth installment in the franchise has grossed $14.3 million from 1,911,190 viewers.

Universal’s “The Odyssey” finished in fourth place in its eleventh weekend, drawing $580,011 from 52,439 admissions across 481 screens to take 8.6% of the frame. The Christopher Nolan-directed epic pushed its haul to $104.1 million from 12,267,696 admissions since opening on Aug. 5.

20th Century Studios’ ocean survival thriller “ Whalefall ” debuted in fifth place, earning $300,004 from 38,637 admissions across 621 screens for 4.4% of the market. Since its mid-week rollout on Oct. 14, the film has accumulated $421,412 from 56,363 viewers.

Director Kore-eda Hirokazu’s live-action manga drama “Look Back” took sixth place in its sophomore frame, taking $194,574 from 24,614 admissions across 271 screens, bringing its cumulative run to $829,170 from 105,345 viewers.

Locus Animation’s local animated adventure “Guardians of the Video Game” opened in seventh place, collecting $165,350 from 22,427 admissions across 566 screens. Adapted from Gasfard’s popular Naver webtoon, the animated fantasy follows an elite game-world administrator demoted to managing a retro mobile video game, generating $295,340 from 42,647 admissions since its Oct. 14 premiere.

Paramount Pictures and Legendary Entertainment’s video game adaptation “ Street Fighter ” debuted in eighth place with $122,148 from 16,813 admissions across 523 screens. The live-action franchise reboot has grossed $238,799 from 34,920 admissions following its Oct. 14 bow.

Japanese supernatural chiller “The Mouths,” directed by Takashi Shimizu, took ninth place in its second weekend, earning $110,302 from 14,991 admissions across 245 screens for a cumulative total of $569,462 from 77,114 viewers.

Rounding out the top ten, Lotte Entertainment’s action fantasy “Reawakened Man,” starring Koo Kyo-hwan, took $73,714 from 10,211 admissions across 292 screens, lifting its total to $2.4 million from 326,734 admissions.

The overall market collective gross for the weekend was $6.7 million, down from last week’s $10.5 million.

"以“佩皮（Pepi）”署名发表作品的霍弗几乎不会说话，听力也很差。绘画对他而言是表达自我的重要手段，他通过粗犷而具象的刻画来表现生活和对周围事物的观察。其中，用红、黄、橙色勾勒出色情裸体的画作最具代表性，给观者留下人物仿佛被关在围栏内的印象。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "画廊运营者克里斯蒂安·贝尔斯特在给美国版ARTnews的邮件中做出了如下悼词。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": article_text:
訃報：アール・ブリュットの代表作家ヨーゼフ・ホーファーが81歳で死去。鮮烈な描写で身体を表現

アール・ブリュット の代表的作家、ヨーゼフ・ホーファーが81歳で死去した。オーストリア生まれのホーファーは、発達 障がい と言語障がいがあり、幼少期には ナチス の迫害を逃れるため身を隠していた。ドローイング表現を追求して独自の作品世界を築き、晩年まで国際的に評価され続けた。

発達 障がい と言語障がいがあり、幼少期には ナチス の迫害を逃れるため、両親によって身を隠されていた経験を持つ、 アール・ブリュット （*1）の代表的作家ヨーゼフ・ホーファーが10月23日、81歳で死去した。仏美術専門紙 Le Quotidien de l’Art が報じた。

*1 アール・ブリュット（Art Brut／生（なま）の芸術）は1940年代にフランスの画家ジャン・デュビュッフェが提唱した概念で、既存の文化や流行、美術界の影響を受けずに制作を行う独学のアーティストなどの作品。

ホーファーがこの秋に最後の個展を開いたパリのギャラリー、クリスチャン・バーストによると、肺の感染症に伴う合併症で入院した後、 オーストリア 北部のリート・イム・インクライスで亡くなった。

「ペピ（Pepi）」の署名で作品を発表していたホーファーは、ほとんど言葉を発することがなく、耳も聞こえにくかった。ドローイングは、彼にとって自らを表現する重要な手段となり、人生や身の回りの観察を、荒々しくも具象的な描写を通して表してきた。なかでも、エロティックな裸体を赤、黄、オレンジの色彩で枠取ったドローイングが代表的で、人物が囲いのなかに閉じ込められているかのような印象を与える。

ギャラリーを運営するクリスチャン・バーストは、US版ARTnewsへのメールで次のように追悼した。

「彼にとって創作は、選択ではなく、生きるために欠かせない営みでした。ドローイングは、世界の中に身を置き、そこに自らの痕跡を残し、あるいは自分の居場所をつくり出す方法だったのでしょう。類まれな強度と人間性を備えた彼の作品は、これからも長く、私たちの心を深く揺さぶり続けるはずです」

ホーファーは1997年、オーストリアで通っていたデッサン教室で出会った美術史家のエリーザベト・テルスニクに見出された。テルスニクはその後、彼を美術機関へと繋ぎ、ヨーロッパ各地で展覧会が開催されるきっかけにもなった。2003年には スイス ・ローザンヌのアール・ブリュット・コレクションで展示が行われ、2010年にはプラハのオーストリア文化フォーラムで回顧展が開催された。さらに2022年には、スイスのヴァルトにあるトゥルガウ美術館／イッティンガー美術館で大規模な展覧会が開かれた。

現在、彼の作品は ポンピドゥー・センター のほか、アントワーヌ・ド・ガルベール、ブルーノ・デシャルム、アルヌルフ・ライナーといった著名なコレクターにも所蔵されている。また、フランス・モンペリエの現代美術センターMo.Coでは、ホーファーの作品を含むアール・ブリュット の展覧会「I Am the Phantom of My Own Opera」が、2026年12月5日から2027年5月2日まで開催される予定だ。

1945年3月17日、オーストリア北部に生まれたホーファーは、同じように精神的・身体的な障がいがあった兄とともに、農村部で外部との接触を制限された環境で育った。ナチス政権の衰退後も、ソ連軍の侵攻を恐れた両親は外部との接触を避け、家族の孤立は続いた。

1977年に父親が亡くなると、一家はキルシュラークへ移住した。そこでホーファーは次第に他者と交流するようになり、リートにある精神科クリニックに入院した。1985年にドローイングの魅力に目覚めてからは、色鉛筆を使い、紙に何千点もの作品を描き続けた。初期には農場での暮らしなどを題材としていたが、やがて エゴン・シーレ の作品にも影響を受けながら、裸体表現へと展開していった。

美術史家のテルスニクは、ホーファーの最後の展覧会に合わせて刊行されたカタログの中で、彼のドローイングについて「それまで私が目にしてきたあらゆるものとは、まったく一線を画す作品だった」と記している。（翻訳：編集部）

editorial_excerpt_zh: 节目名称 新美の巨人たち 超绝技巧的美丽蝴蝶！福田亨【立体木象嵌】×Shishido Kavka 播出电视台 东京电视台 播出时间 2026年10月24日（土） 22:00～22:30 重播（BSテレ東） 2026年10月31日(土) 2
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/a7e421d3ccd7a5b5a66b32dc9cd9df4c.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“网丝蛱蝶”正在喝水。精湛的造型和色彩仿佛它正拥有生命。然而仔细一看……无论是美丽的翅膀花纹、极细的触角与脚，还是清澈透明的水，全都是用木头制作的。这就是年轻雕刻家福田亨独创的超绝技巧【立体木象嵌】。全面紧密追踪其长达半年的制作过程！切割、打磨、嵌入。运用自如的奇迹技艺绝对令人惊叹！“神秘的蝴蝶”究竟是如何诞生的呢。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/340705473918d9ca22ceabe5f6a54263.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/8401655a4e3ced906a072277e62ac82d.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/71017468fcd6a01496fef0c2f3d6edae.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "（读卖新闻美术展Navi编辑班）", "translated": true}]
article_blocks_json: [{"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/a7e421d3ccd7a5b5a66b32dc9cd9df4c.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "「イシガケチョウ」が水を飲んでいます。生きているかのような見事な造形と色彩。でもよく見ると…、美しい翅模様も、極細の触角や脚も、そして透き通る水も、全て木で作られているのです。これぞ若き彫刻家・福田亨さんが編み出した超絶技巧【立体木象嵌】。その半年にわたる制作過程に完全密着！切って、削って、はめ込む。繰り出される奇跡の技に驚愕間違いなし！「神秘のチョウ」は如何にして生まれるのでしょうか。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/340705473918d9ca22ceabe5f6a54263.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/8401655a4e3ced906a072277e62ac82d.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artexhibition.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/71017468fcd6a01496fef0c2f3d6edae.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "美術展ナビ"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "（読売新聞美術展ナビ編集班）"}]
article_text:
「イシガケチョウ」が水を飲んでいます。生きているかのような見事な造形と色彩。でもよく見ると…、美しい翅模様も、極細の触角や脚も、そして透き通る水も、全て木で作られているのです。これぞ若き彫刻家・福田亨さんが編み出した超絶技巧【立体木象嵌】。その半年にわたる制作過程に完全密着！切って、削って、はめ込む。繰り出される奇跡の技に驚愕間違いなし！「神秘のチョウ」は如何にして生まれるのでしょうか。

（読売新聞美術展ナビ編集班）

article_text:
A feature by ArtThrob Editors on the 5th of August 2026. This should take you 6 minutes to read.

KZN Art Fair 07.08 - 09.08.2026

The inaugural KZN Art Fair is set to take stage in the second weekend of August (7-9). As the team finalises plans to welcome tens of thousands of visitors, we reached out to learn more about the initiative and what audiences can expect.

Here’s what they had to say.

Who is behind the KZN Art Fair, and what’s the story of how the team came together?

Angela Shaw (Chief Creative Director) and Lungelo Mkhize (Chief Operations Director) are the co-founders of the KZN Art Fair. Both have long working histories in the arts industry, and their combined skills and experience make a strong partnership. Mkhize had worked towards a new art fair in Durban from 2022 to 2024, which was thwarted by obstacles related to the city and the post Covid-19 economy. Although the Durban Art Fair was shelved, the initiative was extremely well received by the creative sector at the time, and it was clear there was a strong appetite for something like this in the region. When the opportunity to partner with the Hilton Arts Festival arose in 2025, it was an obvious move for Shaw and Mkhize to partner and revisit the initiative.

Lungelo Mkhize

Mkhize was the Shipping Registrar and Art Fair Manager at Stevenson Gallery before founding Section 9, a logistics and art handling business with clients from domestic and international galleries and institutes, artists, and commercial and private collections. His business acumen and training from Atelier 4, Miami in Art Fair Logistics and Administration is invaluable to the management of KZN Art Fair.

Angela Shaw

Shaw has a background in project management, curatorship and exhibition making, and was the Executive Director of the KwaZulu-Natal Society of Arts (KZNSA) from 2014 – 2025. She has an Honours in Curatorship from the University of Cape Town and a Master’s in Curatorial Public and Visual Practice from the University of Witwatersrand. Her area of research focuses on sustainability in the creative sector. Together, Mkhize and Shaw’s combined expertise and wealth of knowledge on the KZN creative ecosystem contribute strong logistics, site management, and stakeholder and arts community liaison. They also bring relevant and exciting programming and curatorial direction to the Fair.

KZNSA Exhibitor Candice Berman Gallery, Johannesburg, Installation View.

The fair is described as ‘KZN Art Fair at Hilton Arts Festival 2026’ – can you explain the connection to the Hilton Arts Festival?

Angela Shaw was approached by the Hilton Arts Festival in early 2025 to consult on bringing HAF’s vision for a professional and sustainable visual art presentation to life. They were interested in how the art at the festival could contribute more to the creative economy and also exist alongside the internationally regarded calibre of the theatre and performances that HAF is known for.

Shaw proposed an art fair, and it was agreed this was the best way to achieve these objectives. An art fair would show the work of career artists and engage galleries and the broader arts industry for a more professional presentation of visual art at the festival, while also creating more opportunity for artists in KZN. The partnership between the KZN Art Fair and the Hilton Arts Festival is mutually beneficial in that it aligns the quality of the performance and visual art presentations, and has provided a supportive environment for the newly formed KZN Art Fair to emerge in the province.

There was an earlier attempt to get a fair like this in Durban off the ground around the COVID period. What does it mean to finally bring it to life now?

The insights so far on this version of a local art fair confirm just how important it is to have a fair in the region. For it to come to life means that the art produced in KZN is relevant in the broader conversation of the South African art industry. It also means that the art of the region can be produced and consumed at a sustainable rate for creative practitioners – and will contribute to exposure, recognition, talent retention and attract investment to the region.

Art Fairs are an important forum where collectors, galleries and artists intersect. They are spaces for artists’ work to be seen by thousands of visitors, and specifically by collectors looking to acquire new work, or familiarise themselves with the practices of artists they follow, or don’t know about yet. Art fairs facilitate industry networking, operate as a cultural barometer and stimulate the creative economy.

KZNAF Exhibitor Art-ists Collective (AC), Durban. Installation image courtesy of AC photo credit Niamh Walsh-Vorster for the exhibition Reintroductions.

How has the reception been so far, from galleries, artists, and the public? Do you feel you have received the support and excitement that you were anticipating in the earlier days of planning?

We were delighted by the response to our call for applications from galleries and collectives, and feel the assortment of exhibitors this year is a dynamic combination of established players and exciting new voices. It has been gratifying to include so many high-calibre KZN exhibitors, either operating as galleries or as collectives representing career artists. There are also participants from around the country who bring a diverse range of mediums and practices to the fair. Public support has been encouraging, with an impressive following of our WhatsApp broadcast channel and our social media platforms. Support from two leading industry sponsors, including Belgotex, has contributed credibility to the fair, and we continue to be grateful to Hilton College for the venue and for the endorsement and buy-in of the uMngeni Municipality and uMngeni Tourism.

Can you walk me through the programming? What can visitors expect, and what are some of the highlights? What are you most looking forward to during the fair itself?

Programming includes the gallery and artist collective booths, an exhibition of KZN craft and design sponsored by Belgotex, an arts publications zone, daily walkabouts, art-making sessions, and a series of panel discussions. We are looking forward to how these come together to showcase the dynamism and professionalism of the KZN creative sector.

Hilton College Memorial Hall, venue for the KZN Art Festival. Photo credit: Niamh Walsh-Vorster

Can you tell us a bit about the venue? What does that setting bring to the fair?

Memorial Hall at Hilton College provides a beautiful, comfortable and spacious environment to install a fair that feels welcoming and also professional. The two exhibition halls, a lecture theatre and a workshop space are arranged around a sunny courtyard with café seating and a wine and coffee bar – a wonderful alternative to a conference centre with its harsh light and white noise! Hilton College itself is an excellent venue partner with an impressive infrastructure, its leadership buy-in to the festival and fair, and the endless operational support from staff.

How would you describe the art and creative ecosystem in Durban and KZN more broadly right now?

Durban and KZN have always been an incubator of creative talent. There are many theories about how this happens, but the common outcome in the past is that this talent leaves because there isn’t enough opportunity to generate income from creative work here. This is why large swathes of the Joburg and Cape Town creative sectors are made up of people from KZN – we refer to this as the Durban Diaspora!

In the last five years, however, there has been a noticeable shift with artists choosing to remain in Durban and self-start initiatives or run their practices locally. The decline in the City of Johannesburg and the soaring cost of living in Cape Town are factors, but the resounding insight is that Durban is cool – an affordable, accessible, no-fuss place to live with great weather, a good quality of life and dynamic creative communities.

Sthenjwa Luthuli and Wonderbuhle are examples of artists thriving internationally from their Durban bases, and they pave the way for others. New gallery initiatives, collectives and studios such as Azania Yethu, Contemporary Archive Project, Art-ists Collective, uMsamo Artists’ Guild and Studio Kalki are also examples of self-led creative businesses, and each of these facilitates communities, platforms and opportunities for locally based artists to practice and sell.

And lastly, how is this fair similar to or different from other art fairs elsewhere in South Africa – in particular Johannesburg and Cape Town?

We are similar in that we represent the work of career artists and value criticality as well as economic impact in the art industry. In this inaugural year, the KZN Art Fair is naturally smaller than our fellow art fairs around the country. We are happy that we have emerged organically in response to genuine demand for a forum like this in our region. In the coming years, we aim to stay close to our roots, honour the work of local practitioners and contribute to the KZN creative economy, while also growing to bring national, African and international voices into the conversation.

article_text:
Cine

Dónde ver (algunas) películas del FICM 2026 tras su paso por el festival

Te contamos qué películas del FICM 2026 llegarán a salas de cine o plataformas de streaming y su fecha de estreno.

El Festival Internacional de Cine de Morelia (FICM) se ha convertido en un referente del cine nacional e internacional a lo largo de sus 24 ediciones. Gran parte de su programación aún no cuenta con una fecha de estreno confirmada en cines o plataformas de streaming, por lo que muchas de ellas podrán ser vistas solo durante el festival o algunos meses, incluso años después. Te compartimos donde podrás ver algunas de las películas proyectadas en el FICM 2026 y su fecha de estreno:

Yo soy Rocky (I Play Rocky)

Fecha de estreno y donde ver: Cines, 12 de noviembre 2026

La famosa película Rocky (1976) fue una idea original de su protagonista Sylvester Stallone, quien escribió la historia de un boxeador que vive en un barrio obrero de Filadelfia y se gana la vida cobrando deudas para un prestamista mientras intenta abrirse camino en el boxeo profesional. Después de escribir el guion de Rocky, consiguió interesar a productores de Hollywood, pero enfrentó un problema: querían comprar su historia sin necesariamente permitirle protagonizarla . Yo soy Rocky cuenta la historia de cómo llegó finalmente a la pantalla grande.

Campeón gabacho

Fecha de estreno y dónde ver: Cines, 29 de octubre de 2026.

Es la función inaugural del Festival Internacional de Cine de Morelia (FICM) este año y está dirigida por Jonás Cuarón , quien estará acompañado por su padre, Alfonso Cuarón, durante el festival. Cuenta la historia de un joven mexicano, Libario, el «chivato», como le dice la mujer de la que se enamora tras su llegada a Nueva York donde descubre que su fuerza física es superior a muchos otros peleadores, incluso profesionales. Está basada en la novela homónima Campeón gabacho (2015), de la escritora mexicana Aura Xilonen.

Klara y el sol (Klara and the Sun)

Fecha de estreno y dónde ver: Cines, 22 de octubre de 2026.

Taika Waititi, director de Klara y el sol, ha forjado un estilo muy característico a nivel formal y de tono. Para esta cinta, contó para Vanity Fair, que inicialmente quiso incorporar mucho más humor absurdo relacionado con los robots, como el que caracteriza a películas suyas como Thor: Ragnarok (2017) o Jojo Rabbit (2019), pero para esta película decidió soltar ese tono para respetar la esencia emocional y filosófica que conlleva la novela en la que está basada.

El bosque salvaje (Wildwood)

Fecha de estreno y dónde ver: Cines, 29 de octubre de 2026.

Wildwood es la sexta película del estudio LAIKA, responsable de Coraline . Es, además, su producción más ambiciosa hasta la fecha, con aproximadamente 16 años de desarrollo y una escala excepcional para una película realizada mediante animación cuadro por cuadro. La historia sigue a Prue McKeel, una adolescente que vive en Portland, Oregón, cuya vida cambia cuando una bandada de cuervos secuestra a su hermano menor, Mac, y lo lleva al interior de un bosque misterioso.

La bola negra

Fecha de estreno y dónde ver: Netflix, 18 de diciembre de 2026. Exhibición limitada en cines anunciada para el 4 de diciembre de 2026.

La bola negra , una de las películas más sonadas para los Oscar 2027, entrelaza las vidas de tres hombres homosexuales en diferentes momentos de la historia española: 1932, 1937 y 2017. Aunque están separados por décadas, los tres protagonistas comparten experiencias relacionadas con el deseo, la represión y la necesidad de vivir libremente.

Ray Gunn

Fecha de estreno y dónde ver: Netflix. Sin fecha de estreno confirmada en México.

Ray Gunn es uno de los estrenos de animación más interesantes de 2026 por tres razones: es el proyecto que Brad Bird lleva intentando realizar más de 30 años, representa su regreso como director de animación después de Los increíbles (2004) Los increíbles 2 (2018) y pretende demostrar que las películas animadas pueden explorar géneros habitualmente asociados con el cine para adultos.

Rose

Fecha de estreno y dónde ver: Cines, 28 de enero de 2027.

Presentada en la sección de Estrenos Internacionales del FICM 2026, Rose está protagonizada por Sandra Hüller, ganadora del Oso de Plata en Berlín por esta interpretación. Ambientada en la Alemania del siglo XVII, sigue a una mujer que se hace pasar por soldado para conseguir independencia y libertad en una sociedad dominada por hombres. Inspirada en casos históricos reales, la película también fue seleccionada para representar a Austria en los Óscar 2027.

El desconocido del gran arco (L’Inconnu de la Grande Arche)

Fecha de estreno y dónde ver: Cineteca Nacional. Sin fecha comercial confirmada.

Como parte de los Estrenos Internacionales del FICM 2026, llega este drama basado en la sorprendente historia real de Johan Otto von Spreckelsen, un arquitecto danés prácticamente desconocido que ganó el concurso para diseñar la Grande Arche de París. Protagonizada por Claes Bang y con Xavier Dolan en el reparto, la película retrata su enfrentamiento con la burocracia y el poder político francés.

Susana Guzmán De la O Escribir y el cine son mis más grandes amores. Admiro a Tarkovski, pero lloro cada que veo Up.

article_text:
Come sopravvivono, da chi sono gestiti e come affrontano la rivoluzione digitale i musei privati del Mezzogiorno? L’ Università “Magna Græcia” di Catanzaro (UMG) si è posta questo interrogativo e ha risposto analizzando organizzazione, risorse economiche e trasformazione digitale di 69 musei privati del Sud Italia. Quanto può incidere la disponibilità economica sulla capacità di un museo di innovare, assumere personale qualificato e adeguarsi agli standard richiesti dal sistema museale nazionale? L’indagine, presentata il 24 settembre al Pio Monte della Misericordia di Napoli durante il seminario Organizzare l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione nei Musei: prospettive di ricerca, restituisce il quadro di un settore caratterizzato da strutture organizzative ridotte, risorse limitate e una diffusione disomogenea delle tecnologie digitali.

La ricerca ha censito 69 musei su un totale di 241 strutture private individuate in Abruzzo, Basilicata, Calabria, Campania, Molise, Puglia, Sardegna e Sicilia, tenendo in considerazione realtà diocesane ed ecclesiastiche, che rappresentano il 30,4% del campione, ma anche fondazioni, associazioni, musei etnografici e case museo. A fronte di questa varietà, secondo i dati presentati emerge una difficoltà comune: soltanto 44 dei 241 musei privati censiti nel Mezzogiorno fanno parte del Sistema Museale Nazionale, soprattutto per le difficoltà riscontrate nel soddisfare gli standard minimi richiesti.

Anche le dimensioni del personale restituiscono un quadro significativo: il 71% dei musei coinvolti dichiara di avere meno di cinque dipendenti, mentre l’organizzazione delle attività si fonda sulla compresenza di personale interno, presente nel 63,8% dei casi, e volontari non retribuiti, indicati dal 49,2% degli intervistati. La fragilità si riflette nei bilanci: l’81% delle strutture non supera i 35mila euro di fatturato annuo, mentre il 46,6% resta al di sotto dei 5mila euro. Si tratta di cifre che, secondo la ricerca, contribuiscono a delineare i margini ristretti entro cui molti musei sono chiamati a organizzare le proprie attività.

Le competenze necessarie e i limiti del reclutamento

Alla gestione delle collezioni e alle competenze tecnico-scientifiche si affiancano esigenze legate alla governance, alla comunicazione, al marketing e al project management. La trasformazione delle istituzioni museali richiede infatti professionalità capaci di affrontare anche le questioni organizzative e tecnologiche.

Tra gli ambiti in cui i musei ritengono necessario investire, il 42% indica le competenze tecniche, il 40,6% la digitalizzazione e il 31,9% le cosiddette soft skill, tra cui adattabilità, creatività e intelligenza emotiva.

La necessità di ampliare le competenze si scontra tuttavia con la difficoltà di reperire risorse per nuove assunzioni: il 56,5% degli intervistati individua nei vincoli di bilancio il principale ostacolo al reclutamento, mentre il 21,7% segnala la mancanza di candidati adeguatamente preparati. Per individuare nuove professionalità, il 62,3% delle strutture ricorre a reti relazionali e conoscenze informali; nel 50,7% dei casi vengono utilizzati anche i contatti con il mondo universitario e i tirocini.

La digitalizzazione e il ruolo dell’intelligenza artificiale

Sul fronte tecnologico, i dati mostrano livelli di adozione differenti, con soltanto tre musei su 69 che dichiarano un grado di digitalizzazione molto alto, mentre il 31,9% si colloca su un livello intermedio; il 30,4% afferma, invece, di non utilizzare tecnologie avanzate. Tra gli strumenti maggiormente diffusi figurano i sistemi di biglietteria elettronica, indicati dal 29% del campione, le tecnologie immersive, utilizzate dal 27,5%, e i sistemi di gestione delle collezioni, presenti nel 26,1% dei casi.

Più contenuto è il ricorso all’intelligenza artificiale: soltanto sette musei, pari al 10,1% degli intervistati, dichiarano di impiegarla nelle proprie attività, dato che scende a zero quando si considera il reclutamento del personale, ambito nel quale nessuno dei musei coinvolti dichiara di utilizzare strumenti di IA. Tra le principali preoccupazioni, il 47,8% segnala il rischio di perdere il controllo umano sui processi decisionali, il 26,1% la mancanza di competenze interne e il 21,7% il possibile emergere di pregiudizi algoritmici. L’assenza di applicazioni dell’IA nella selezione del personale non coincide, tuttavia, con una chiusura generalizzata verso le tecnologie, considerando che guardando agli sviluppi futuri i musei intervistati indicano possibili impieghi soprattutto nella gestione delle collezioni, citata dal 47,8%, nel marketing, dal 46,4%, e nell’analisi dei visitatori, dal 42%. Soltanto il 2,9% manifesta invece interesse per applicazioni legate al reclutamento.

I risultati sono stati presentati dal gruppo di ricerca del Dipartimento di Giurisprudenza, Economia e Sociologia dell’Università Magna Græcia, coordinato dai professori Rocco Reina , Marzia Ventura e Francesco Rania , insieme alle dottorande Giorgia Alcaro , Giovanna Bile e Anna Maria Correale . Il seminario, patrocinato dalla Fondazione con il Sud e dal Comitato ICOM Campania, ha riunito rappresentanti di università, istituzioni culturali e musei, tra cui il Museo Cappella Sansevero e il MUDD .

article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "Eine 17-jährige baskische Schülerin enthüllt ihrer Familie, dass sie nach dem Abitur nicht studieren, sondern Nonne werden will. Bei ihren Verwandten fallen die Reaktionen sehr unterschiedlich aus und offenbaren viel über Ängste, Sehnsüchte und Vorstellungen. Aus dieser Konstellation entwickelt das Drama „Glaube“ eine feine erzählerische Balance im Ringen um schwerwiegende Entscheidungen. Der Film der Spanierin Alauda Ruiz de Azúa ist neuer Kinotipp der Katholischen Filmkritik."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Die 17-jährige Ainara ( Blanca Soroa ) ist eine kluge Schülerin, die in der baskischen Stadt Bilbao ein von Nonnen geführtes Gymnasium besucht. Kurz vor dem Abitur gibt sie preis, dass sie unerwartete Zukunftspläne hegt. Nach dem Schulabschluss will sie nicht studieren, sondern in einen Frauenorden eintreten. Nach dem Tod ihrer Mutter vor ein paar Jahren ist Ainaras Tante Maite ( Patricia López Arnaiz ) zu einer wichtigen Bezugsperson geworden, Maite ist jedoch kirchen- und religionsfeindlich eingestellt und dementsprechend entsetzt über die Pläne ihrer Nichte. Ainaras Vater Iñaki ( Miguel Garcés ) sieht den Wunsch seiner Tochter dagegen pragmatisch und will ihr diesen nicht grundsätzlich untersagen. Bei den sonntäglichen Runden der Großfamilie bearbeitet Maite ihren Bruder jedoch weiter, gegen das Vorhaben seiner Tochter vorzugehen und sie zum Studium ins Ausland zu schicken. Iñaki ist allerdings mehr mit seinem überschuldeten Restaurant und einer neuen Frau an seiner Seite beschäftigt und flippt erst aus, als Ainaras stille Selbstsicherheit seine Autorität in Frage stellt. Die kämpferische Tante dagegen lässt nichts unversucht und agitiert sogar an der Schule, vor allem, als sie von einem Mitschüler erfährt, für den sich ihre Nichte interessiert.", "links": [{"text": "Blanca Soroa", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/person/details/478230/blanca-soroa"}, {"text": "Patricia López Arnaiz", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/person/details/323742/patricia-lopez-arnaiz"}, {"text": "Miguel Garcés", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/person/details/454171/miguel-garces"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Die spanische Regisseurin Alauda Ruiz de Azúa zeigt in ihrem Drama „ Glaube “, wie eine Familie von dem Wunsch nach einem Leben betroffen wird, der außerhalb ihrer Vorstellung liegt. Für Ainara verbindet sich mit der Klostergemeinschaft das Gefühl von Freiheit und Liebe, doch auf ihr Umfeld wirkt das Ordensleben vielmehr wie der Widerspruch zum freiheitlichen Leben. Die Filmemacherin verhandelt damit im Familienrahmen einen Zwiespalt der heutigen Gesellschaften zwischen säkularer Ausrichtung und weiterhin stark religiöser Prägung. In Spanien etwa besuchen noch immer rund zwanzig Prozent der Schüler eine kirchliche oder von einem Orden betriebene Schule, trotz dieser im europäischen Vergleich hohen Zahl bezeichnet sich jedoch die Mehrheit der Spanier als „nicht kirchlich“ und „nicht religiös“. Für die Regisseurin spielt dabei das Thema der Familie eine zentrale Rolle. Im Original heißt der Film „Los Domingos“, was nicht nur auf den konfessionellen Rahmen des spanischen Katholizismus, sondern mehr noch auf dessen soziale Gestalt in Form enger Familienbande anspielt. Dabei geht es keineswegs nur um Weltanschauungsfragen, sondern weit mehr noch um alles, worauf menschliches Grundvertrauen basiert.", "links": [{"text": "Alauda Ruiz de Azúa", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/person/details/440303/alauda-ruiz-de-azua"}, {"text": "Glaube", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/film/details/625488/glaube"}]}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/bild/filmdb/370849/glaube-szenenbild-2.jpg?t=1782310301", "alt": "Die Tante (r.) glaubt nicht an die Berufung der Nichte", "caption": "Die Tante (r.) glaubt nicht an die Berufung der Nichte (© MFA+/David Herranz)", "credit": "Filmdienst"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Verteidigung der Freiheit bei Entscheidungen"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "„Glaube“ ist von der Jury der Katholischen Filmkritik zum neuen Kinotipp gewählt worden. „Der ruhige und vielschichtige Film stellt unbequeme Fragen nach Freiheit, Glauben und Selbstbestimmung, ohne den Zuschauer zu belehren“, heißt es in der Begründung der Jury. Durchaus provokant stelle der Film in den Raum, ob Freiheit auch dann noch als solche wahrgenommen und verteidigt werde, wenn die Entscheidung eines anderen einem selbst komplett gegen den Strich gehe. Dies gelinge, indem die Inszenierung mit klaren und unaufgeregten Bildern das Familiendrama vor den Augen der Zuschauenden auffächere, so die Jury. Dabei stünden gar nicht so sehr die Argumentationen für und wider Glauben und Kirche im Zentrum, vor allem, da sich die Berufung der Hauptfigur letztlich jeder Überprüfbarkeit entziehe. Den Kern des Films sieht die Jury an anderer Stelle: „Der Film verzichtet auf melodramatische Knalleffekte und gewinnt seine Wucht aus der genauen Beobachtung familiärer Loyalitätsgrenzen.“"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Als entscheidend für ihre Wahl notierte die Kinotipp-Jury auch, wie offen die Filmemacherin mit ihrer Hauptfigur umgehe. „Ruiz de Azúa pathologisiert ihre Protagonistin weder, noch stilisiert sie sie zur verblendeten Märtyrerin.“ Ainaras kompromisslose Hinwendung zum Sakralen lasse sich zwar auch als ultimativ provokanter Akt einer Siebzehnjährigen in einer säkularisierten Welt verstehen, der Jugendlichen selber lege eine provokative Haltung gänzlich fern. „Ihre Entscheidung fordert aber die Familie, und mit ihr auch die Zuschauenden, heraus, Haltung zu beziehen gegenüber einem Glauben, der einen so radikalen Lebensentwurf von ihr fordert“, präzisierte die Jury. Diese Haltungen liegen irgendwo zwischen Misstrauen – gegenüber ihrer Motivation, den kirchlichen Bezugspersonen, der Tragfähigkeit dieser Entscheidung – und der Bewunderung ihres stillen Selbstbewusstseins."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Indem viele Positionen über die Dialoge verhandelt werden, besitze „Glaube“ zwar auch eine gewisse Thesenhaftigkeit, räumte die Jury ein. Allerdings sei der Film fern von simplem Thesenkino. „Die erzählerische Stärke ist das Nebeneinander verschiedener, in sich berechtigter Haltungen“, erklärte die Jury. So gebe es den Pragmatismus des Vaters, der für seine älteste Tochter das Beste will, die Beharrlichkeit der Oberin des Klosters, die Ainara in ihrer Berufung begleiten möchte, aber auch die Ablehnung durch die Tante, die befürchtet, dass ihre Nichte einem Irrtum erliegt. Auch wenn Zuschauende die Entscheidung der Hauptfigur nicht nachvollziehen könnten, werfe das ungewöhnlich durchdachte Drehbuch so viele Fragen auf, dass der Film noch lange zum Nachdenken anrege, so die Jury."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "„ Glaube “ läuft ab 29. Oktober in deutschen Kinos.", "links": [{"text": "Glaube", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/film/details/625488/glaube"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Hinweis"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Der „ Kinotipp der Katholischen Filmkritik “ hebt Filme hervor, die in besonderer Weise religiöse Themen aufgreifen, von menschlichen Nöten, Sorgen und Hoffnungen erzählen und Antworten auf existenzielle Fragen formulieren.", "links": [{"text": "Kinotipp der Katholischen Filmkritik", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/empfehlungen/kinotipp"}]}]
article_text:
Eine 17-jährige baskische Schülerin enthüllt ihrer Familie, dass sie nach dem Abitur nicht studieren, sondern Nonne werden will. Bei ihren Verwandten fallen die Reaktionen sehr unterschiedlich aus und offenbaren viel über Ängste, Sehnsüchte und Vorstellungen. Aus dieser Konstellation entwickelt das Drama „Glaube“ eine feine erzählerische Balance im Ringen um schwerwiegende Entscheidungen. Der Film der Spanierin Alauda Ruiz de Azúa ist neuer Kinotipp der Katholischen Filmkritik.

Die 17-jährige Ainara ( Blanca Soroa ) ist eine kluge Schülerin, die in der baskischen Stadt Bilbao ein von Nonnen geführtes Gymnasium besucht. Kurz vor dem Abitur gibt sie preis, dass sie unerwartete Zukunftspläne hegt. Nach dem Schulabschluss will sie nicht studieren, sondern in einen Frauenorden eintreten. Nach dem Tod ihrer Mutter vor ein paar Jahren ist Ainaras Tante Maite ( Patricia López Arnaiz ) zu einer wichtigen Bezugsperson geworden, Maite ist jedoch kirchen- und religionsfeindlich eingestellt und dementsprechend entsetzt über die Pläne ihrer Nichte. Ainaras Vater Iñaki ( Miguel Garcés ) sieht den Wunsch seiner Tochter dagegen pragmatisch und will ihr diesen nicht grundsätzlich untersagen. Bei den sonntäglichen Runden der Großfamilie bearbeitet Maite ihren Bruder jedoch weiter, gegen das Vorhaben seiner Tochter vorzugehen und sie zum Studium ins Ausland zu schicken. Iñaki ist allerdings mehr mit seinem überschuldeten Restaurant und einer neuen Frau an seiner Seite beschäftigt und flippt erst aus, als Ainaras stille Selbstsicherheit seine Autorität in Frage stellt. Die kämpferische Tante dagegen lässt nichts unversucht und agitiert sogar an der Schule, vor allem, als sie von einem Mitschüler erfährt, für den sich ihre Nichte interessiert.

Die spanische Regisseurin Alauda Ruiz de Azúa zeigt in ihrem Drama „ Glaube “, wie eine Familie von dem Wunsch nach einem Leben betroffen wird, der außerhalb ihrer Vorstellung liegt. Für Ainara verbindet sich mit der Klostergemeinschaft das Gefühl von Freiheit und Liebe, doch auf ihr Umfeld wirkt das Ordensleben vielmehr wie der Widerspruch zum freiheitlichen Leben. Die Filmemacherin verhandelt damit im Familienrahmen einen Zwiespalt der heutigen Gesellschaften zwischen säkularer Ausrichtung und weiterhin stark religiöser Prägung. In Spanien etwa besuchen noch immer rund zwanzig Prozent der Schüler eine kirchliche oder von einem Orden betriebene Schule, trotz dieser im europäischen Vergleich hohen Zahl bezeichnet sich jedoch die Mehrheit der Spanier als „nicht kirchlich“ und „nicht religiös“. Für die Regisseurin spielt dabei das Thema der Familie eine zentrale Rolle. Im Original heißt der Film „Los Domingos“, was nicht nur auf den konfessionellen Rahmen des spanischen Katholizismus, sondern mehr noch auf dessen soziale Gestalt in Form enger Familienbande anspielt. Dabei geht es keineswegs nur um Weltanschauungsfragen, sondern weit mehr noch um alles, worauf menschliches Grundvertrauen basiert.

Verteidigung der Freiheit bei Entscheidungen

„Glaube“ ist von der Jury der Katholischen Filmkritik zum neuen Kinotipp gewählt worden. „Der ruhige und vielschichtige Film stellt unbequeme Fragen nach Freiheit, Glauben und Selbstbestimmung, ohne den Zuschauer zu belehren“, heißt es in der Begründung der Jury. Durchaus provokant stelle der Film in den Raum, ob Freiheit auch dann noch als solche wahrgenommen und verteidigt werde, wenn die Entscheidung eines anderen einem selbst komplett gegen den Strich gehe. Dies gelinge, indem die Inszenierung mit klaren und unaufgeregten Bildern das Familiendrama vor den Augen der Zuschauenden auffächere, so die Jury. Dabei stünden gar nicht so sehr die Argumentationen für und wider Glauben und Kirche im Zentrum, vor allem, da sich die Berufung der Hauptfigur letztlich jeder Überprüfbarkeit entziehe. Den Kern des Films sieht die Jury an anderer Stelle: „Der Film verzichtet auf melodramatische Knalleffekte und gewinnt seine Wucht aus der genauen Beobachtung familiärer Loyalitätsgrenzen.“

Als entscheidend für ihre Wahl notierte die Kinotipp-Jury auch, wie offen die Filmemacherin mit ihrer Hauptfigur umgehe. „Ruiz de Azúa pathologisiert ihre Protagonistin weder, noch stilisiert sie sie zur verblendeten Märtyrerin.“ Ainaras kompromisslose Hinwendung zum Sakralen lasse sich zwar auch als ultimativ provokanter Akt einer Siebzehnjährigen in einer säkularisierten Welt verstehen, der Jugendlichen selber lege eine provokative Haltung gänzlich fern. „Ihre Entscheidung fordert aber die Familie, und mit ihr auch die Zuschauenden, heraus, Haltung zu beziehen gegenüber einem Glauben, der einen so radikalen Lebensentwurf von ihr fordert“, präzisierte die Jury. Diese Haltungen liegen irgendwo zwischen Misstrauen – gegenüber ihrer Motivation, den kirchlichen Bezugspersonen, der Tragfähigkeit dieser Entscheidung – und der Bewunderung ihres stillen Selbstbewusstseins.

Indem viele Positionen über die Dialoge verhandelt werden, besitze „Glaube“ zwar auch eine gewisse Thesenhaftigkeit, räumte die Jury ein. Allerdings sei der Film fern von simplem Thesenkino. „Die erzählerische Stärke ist das Nebeneinander verschiedener, in sich berechtigter Haltungen“, erklärte die Jury. So gebe es den Pragmatismus des Vaters, der für seine älteste Tochter das Beste will, die Beharrlichkeit der Oberin des Klosters, die Ainara in ihrer Berufung begleiten möchte, aber auch die Ablehnung durch die Tante, die befürchtet, dass ihre Nichte einem Irrtum erliegt. Auch wenn Zuschauende die Entscheidung der Hauptfigur nicht nachvollziehen könnten, werfe das ungewöhnlich durchdachte Drehbuch so viele Fragen auf, dass der Film noch lange zum Nachdenken anrege, so die Jury.

„ Glaube “ läuft ab 29. Oktober in deutschen Kinos.

Hinweis

Der „ Kinotipp der Katholischen Filmkritik “ hebt Filme hervor, die in besonderer Weise religiöse Themen aufgreifen, von menschlichen Nöten, Sorgen und Hoffnungen erzählen und Antworten auf existenzielle Fragen formulieren.

title_original: Paris Photo 2026 celebrates 200 years of photography
editorial_title_zh: 2026年巴黎国际摄影艺术展庆祝摄影诞生200周年
editorial_excerpt_zh: 2026年巴黎国际摄影艺术展（Paris Photo）在巴黎大皇宫（Grand Palais）通过多元的展示与推介活动纪念摄影术诞辰二百周年，回顾这一媒介的过去与持续演变
